description: Category 1 (numerical) questions with integer answers, authored from the challenge sample questions and reference images in questions/loft/questions.pdf. Objects are restricted to salient, visually verifiable furniture and decor so a human can confirm every answer from the scene. Each question carries a machine-readable spec that scripts/eval/verify_benchmark2.py re-evaluates against the iref_vla object bounding boxes.
notes: Q01 is the official Category 1 sample question from questions/loft/questions.pdf; its answer (2) is the answer printed in the PDF.
difficulty: easy = single salient object class; medium = one relation or a floor/region restriction; hard = two chained relations.
The loft spans three iref regions: region 2 is the main floor (living + dining), region 1 is the entry area, region 0 is the mezzanine above.

Q01 is the only question in the whole benchmark whose spec pins explicit object ids. The iref color labels for this scene mark seven of the eight sofa pillows 'gray' even though two render as dark charcoal, so the two dark pillows could only be identified from the reference image.
Q03 and Q04 are deliberately paired: eight of the nine chairs are at the dining table and the ninth is on the mezzanine.
Paintings are not used as a count target: the triptych above the TV cabinet is annotated twice (34 and 111) with different extents.
object_ids lists supporting iref_vla scene-graph ids for auditing; SAM3 should use target_objects.

questions.question: How many black pillows are on the sofa?
questions.evidence: Two dark pillows sit among the eight on the sectional: 89 on the end module and 91 on the corner module. The iref color labels call almost every pillow in this scene 'gray', so the two dark ones were identified from the reference image and are pinned by id in the spec.

questions.question: How many pillows are on the sectional sofa?
questions.evidence: Eight pillows (54, 55, 84, 85, 89, 90, 91, 112) are spread over the five modules of the corner sofa; the ninth pillow in the scene is on the mezzanine.

questions.question: How many chairs are around the dining table?
questions.evidence: Eight chairs (10, 94, 95, 96, 97, 98, 99, 100) surround dining table 9 on the main floor.

questions.question: How many chairs are in the loft in total?
questions.evidence: The eight dining chairs plus the brown armchair (74) on the mezzanine.

questions.question: How many tall vases are standing on the floor next to the TV cabinet?
questions.evidence: Two tall wooden vases (14, 15) stand on the floor beside the TV cabinet; the third vase on the main floor sits on furniture.

questions.question: How many potted plants are on the main floor?
questions.evidence: Three potted plants (25, 109, 110) stand on the main floor; the potted bamboo is in the entry area.

questions.question: How many doors are along the east wall of the main floor?
questions.evidence: Four identical dark doors (37, 38, 39, 40) line the east wall of the main floor.

questions.question: How many books are on the table on the mezzanine?
questions.evidence: Books 58 and 72 lie on desk 22 on the mezzanine; the third book in the loft is on a coffee table downstairs.

questions.question: How many boots are on the shoe rack?
questions.evidence: A pair of boots (49, 50) stands on shoe rack 6 on the mezzanine.

questions.question: How many cups are on the table with the bowl of apples on it?
questions.evidence: The bowl of apples (7) rests on dining table 9, which also holds cup 107 and coffee cup 113; the third cup is on a coffee table by the sofa.
